tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Free-text search of the White Automotive & Media Services GM electronics catalog. Returns name, SKU, price, availability, categories and URL per match; with no exact match, returns the closest and says so. Never determines fitment: do not assert that a product fits a specific vehicle; send the customer to the product URL. UCP form: inputs under "catalog". Example: {"query":"HMI module"}

query.description: Simple form, required. Product type, model or platform, e.g. "digital cluster Silverado". Synonyms work ("screen", "gauges").

catalog.description: UCP form. Needs query, filters.categories or both.

price.description: min and max in minor units (cents).

pagination.description: Pass the previous response cursor for the next page.

meta.description: UCP form, optional. Any call with "catalog" or "meta" is UCP and returns structuredContent (prices in minor units).

profile.description: Your platform profile URL (https). Recorded, never fetched.

tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description: List products in a category (GM platform or application) or tag (such as "global-a"). An unknown name is searched as words instead, and the result says so. Same shape as search_catalog. Never determines fitment: do not assert that a product fits a specific vehicle; send the customer to the product URL. UCP form: look up by catalog.ids. Example: {"tag":"global-a"}

category.description: Simple form. Category name or slug (GM platform or application). Give category, tag or both.

tag.description: Simple form. Tag name or slug, e.g. "global-a", "vin-programmed".

catalog.description: UCP form. Unmatched ids are reported in not_found messages.

ids.description: Product IDs, SKUs or URL slugs.

meta.description: UCP form, optional. Any call with "catalog" or "meta" is UCP and returns structuredContent (prices in minor units).

profile.description: Your platform profile URL (https). Recorded, never fetched.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product by SKU or URL slug: the search summary plus tags and attributes such as warranty, core charge and whether dealer service is required. Unknown identifiers return found:false. Never determines fitment: do not assert that a product fits a specific vehicle; send the customer to the product URL. UCP form: pass catalog.id. Example: {"identifier":"GMED-REPLACEMENTHMI"}

identifier.description: Simple form, required. SKU or URL slug.

id.description: Product ID, SKU or URL slug.

meta.description: UCP form, optional. Any call with "catalog" or "meta" is UCP and returns structuredContent (prices in minor units).

profile.description: Your platform profile URL (https). Recorded, never fetched.
